description:
Get the engine versions available for a service type in a project. Works for any `service_type` (`pg`, `kafka`, `opensearch`, `clickhouse`, `valkey`, `mysql`, `flink`, `grafana`, ...).

Call this before `aiven_service_create` so you can tell the user which engine version they are about to get. Never hardcode or guess a version number.

Returns:
- default_version: The major version Aiven uses when the version is not specified. **Report this to the user.**
- available_versions: Every major version that can be selected for a new service, oldest first.
- latest_available_version: The newest full version string (e.g. `18.6`). This is informational — it is **not** the same as `default_version`, and is usually not what you pass to `aiven_service_create`.
- version_config_key: The `user_config` key that sets the version for this service type (e.g. `pg_version`).
- description: Human-readable service type description.

`available_versions` may be empty for service types that are not versioned (e.g. `kafka_connect`, `thanos`); that is not an error — simply omit the version key when creating.
name: aiven_service_type_get
title: Service Type Get
